scope.purpose: Ask for exactly one choice among a few mutually exclusive options that should all stay visible.
useCases: A required question in a form (delivery method) inside Field.
A short horizontal group (Yes / No) with orientation horizontal.
exclusions: Long lists or limited space: Select (wave 4).
Card-style options and segmented buttons: later (SegmentedControl).
alternatives: Switch for an immediate on/off setting.

decisionsTaken: A standalone text entry or radio group takes its accessible name from an optional, non-displayed label prop (the IconButton precedent); inside a Field the Field label wins. There is no visually hidden Field label: a control without a visible label is used without Field.

RadioGroup is a compound component: its options are Radio children (contract-format: the child component is declared in accepts with min 2). Radio gets its own contract and status in the same wave; it is only usable inside a RadioGroup.

Keyboard per the WAI-ARIA radio group pattern: one tab stop, arrows move and select (both axes in either orientation, wrapping), Space selects; a readonly group lets arrows move focus without selecting.
Gaps space.content.sm between stacked radios and space.content.lg between radios on a line (density aware); size, readonly, invalid and disabled are set on the group and apply to every radio.
